translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar Daudi.

content.text: Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, isenona
kendo ingʼeya.
Ingʼeya sa ma abet piny nyaka sa ma aa malo;
adier, ingʼeyo parona gi kuma bor.
Bende ingʼeyo yorega ma aluwo kod kuonde ma ayweyoe;
yorena duto oyangoreni maber.
Kata kapok wach moro owuok e dhoga
to ingʼeye malongʼo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye.
Ilwora koni gi koni mi iketa diere;
adier, iseuma duto gi lweti.
Rieko ma kamano lichna miwuoro,
kendo otutna moyombo pacha.
Dadhi kure eka apond ne Roho mari?
Koso kanye ma daring adhiye mondo apondni?
Ka aidho e polo, to in kuno;
ka aloso kitandana e bur matut, to in kuno.
Ka aidho yamb kogwen
mondo otera e tok nam komachielo,
to kata kuno bende lweti biro telonae,
kendo lweti ma korachwich biro maka motegno.
Ka awacho niya, “Mudho biro ima adier
kendo ler biro lokorena otieno,”
to in mudho ok timni mudho
kendo otieno rienyni ka odiechiengʼ,
nimar mudho chaloni ler.
In ema ne ichweyo dhanda maiye,
adier, ne ingʼina maber gi ei minwa.
Apaki nikech ne ichweya mongʼith kendo malich miwuoro;
tijeni misetimo lich,
kendo angʼeyo mano maber.
Fuonde mag ringra ne ok opondoni,
kane ochweya ei minwa,
kane ochwe ringra e kama opondo,
wangʼi ne oneno ringra ei minwa;
ndalona duto e piny-ka ne ondiki chon gi lala,
e kitabu mari kane pok kata achiel kuomgi obetie.
Mano kaka pachi tutna, yaye Nyasaye!
Mano kaka gingʼeny mokalo akwana kargi duto!
Ka dine bed ni anyalo kwanogi,
to dine giloyo kuoyo gi ngʼeny.
Sa ma achiew to ayudo
ni pod an mana kodi.
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, mad iyie ineg joma timbegi richo!
Ayiuru buta, un joma rich chwero remb ji omakogi!
Giwuoyo kuomi gi paro marach;
adier, wasiki tiyo gi nyingi e yo marach.
Donge amon gi jomamon kodi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye,
koso donge ok awinjra gi joma chungʼ mondo oked kodi?
Achayogi kendo aonge kodgi gi tich
adier akwanogi kaka wasika.
Nona, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, mondo ingʼe chunya;
tema, mondo ingʼe pacha.
Tim kamano mondo ineane ka nitie gimoro marach kuoma,
mondo itera e yor ngima mochwere.
